description: Wave 0 adversarial English pass over 134 new and changed keys (15 already-ruled keys excluded). Remaining keys were read with their render sites and each had one plausible reading.

entries.complaint: "Base" collides with the Base scenario and does not say base of what
readings: elevation of the tank bottom
elevation in the Base scenario
base of the structure including its foundation
entries.resolution: Rewritten: "Base elevation" -> "Bottom elevation"

entries.complaint: "Depth" alone reads as pipe burial depth or depth of cover
readings: depth of water in the tank
burial depth of a node or pipe
entries.resolution: Rewritten: "Depth" -> "Water depth"

entries.complaint: dangling "zoom to" leaves the object of the preposition open
readings: drag a rectangle that you zoom to
zoom to the area the rectangle encloses
entries.resolution: Rewritten: "Zoom Window: drag a rectangle to zoom to." -> "Zoom Window: drag a rectangle on the map to zoom to that area."

entries.complaint: "named" for a pattern: the visitor-facing term for a library reference is the ID, as in lpn_link_end_unknown
readings: no pattern has this ID
no pattern carries this descriptive name
entries.resolution: Rewritten: "No pattern in this project is named {id}, so the junction was left as it was." -> "No pattern in this project has the ID {id}, so the junction was left as it was."

entries.complaint: "unselects whatever is selected" departs from the Select/Selection vocabulary
readings: clear the map selection
deselect a single item
entries.resolution: Rewritten: "Use this mode to change, move, and drag assets and text on the map, or to pan the map. This is the default mode for the map. Pressing Esc a second time unselects whatever is selected." -> "Use this mode to change, move, and drag assets and text on the map, or to pan the map. This is the default mode for the map. Pressing Esc a second time clears the selection."

entries.complaint: "also exists outside" has two possible subjects, the node or the link
readings: the node exists outside the scenario
the link exists outside the scenario
entries.resolution: Rewritten: "{id} is not deleted, because link {link} ends on it and also exists outside {scenario}. To delete both, delete them in the {base} scenario." -> "{id} is not deleted, because link {link} ends on it, and that link also exists outside {scenario}. To delete both, delete them in the {base} scenario."

entries.complaint: "sharper-than-screen" is an unusual compound; "to mark up and then copy" does not say what is marked up
readings: the picture is marked up
the map area is marked up before the picture
sharper means focus rather than resolution
entries.resolution: Rewritten: "Take a sharper-than-screen picture of the map area you drag, to mark up and then copy into a report with the Copy button. Click without dragging to take the whole map." -> "Take a picture of the map area you drag, at a higher resolution than the screen. Mark it up, then copy it into a report with the Copy button. Click without dragging to take the whole map."

entries.complaint: "the current selection" collides with the reserved map-selection sense; the shortcut carries selected text from the page
readings: the map selection
text highlighted on the page
entries.resolution:
Rewritten: "
?Open the guide at the control under the pointer or holding focus.
F1Open the guide at the entry for the box that has f" -> "
?Open the guide at the control under the pointer or holding focus.
F1Open the guide at the entry for the box that has f"

entries.complaint: "across / down" does not say which key goes which way; "Navigate" for backward movement is vague
readings: Tab goes across and Enter goes down
either key goes either way
entries.resolution:
Rewritten: "
Arrow keysNavigate.
Tab, EnterFinish entry and navigate across / down one cell.
Shift+Tab, Shift+Enter" -> "
Arrow keysNavigate.
Tab, EnterFinish the entry and move one cell across (Tab) or down (Enter).
Shift+T"

entries.complaint: Copy button is not named
entries.resolution: Copy is the visible button label beside the heading; one reading.

entries.complaint: "in chosen units" could be unit set or unit menu
entries.resolution: Established phrasing for the unit the visitor chose in the menu; Tom's choose/chosen rule for menu options.

entries.complaint: roughness symbol set per method
entries.resolution: Each symbol is named with its method and the typical values are stated; one reading.

entries.complaint: "From {menu}" could be origin of a movement
entries.resolution: Heading over a group of boxes opened from that menu (js guide builder); {menu} is a menu name, one reading.

entries.complaint: "Guide" noun or verb
entries.resolution: Menu item beside Help; "Guide" as noun is the only reading in a toolbar menu and the title of the box.

entries.complaint: "Contents" as table of contents or things contained
entries.resolution: Sits on a rail with the guide entries listed under it and next to Hide/Show contents; one reading.

entries.complaint: "Current"/"All" lack a noun
entries.resolution: The radio group heading (Tables or Scenarios) supplies the noun at render; gender agreement is the translator's routine task. A split into two keys per group is not worth 4 retranslations.

entries.complaint: "All" lacks a noun
entries.resolution: See lpn_export_table_current.

entries.complaint: Yes/No without the question
entries.resolution: Answers lpn_split_pipe_ask, shown directly above the buttons; a Yes/No button is standard in every language.

entries.complaint: "method" is unexplained
entries.resolution: The panel immediately offers Node, Free point and Coordinates; one reading.

entries.complaint: "text size" may mean the Text asset
entries.resolution: Matches the setting "Text size (pixels)" which scales every label; the setting name is the referent.

entries.complaint: "chosen" vs stated/selected for curve references
entries.resolution: A drop-down option, so choose/chosen is correct per the menu/dialog rule.

entries.complaint: "ends in three periods" is an unusual way to say ellipsis
entries.resolution: The three characters are shown literally in the file; the string is exact and unambiguous.
